title: NuGet package for library consumers
lead: Publish the squalify library as a versioned NuGet package so a .NET consumer can pin it instead of calling the CLI. **Not in this slice:** a public feed choice beyond what the owner names, API changes.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The first downstream consumer (a lab sweep-table splitter in another repo) will reference squalify as a pinned package once delimited profiling and the consumer contract (sq-25) are built.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- the library project (package metadata: id, version, license Apache-2.0, readme), `Directory.Build.props` if versioning lives there, README (how to reference the package)

- Owner decisions (2026-10-27, setup): package id `squalor.squalify` (the assembly and namespace); the package version is the version `tool.version` reports in descriptors (one string, from Directory.Build.props, first package 0.1.0 while the schema is a draft before sq-12); publish nowhere: the package is built and tested from a local folder feed only, and publishing is a separate owner step.

- Owner decision (2026-10-27): CI runs the Package-category tests as one step on every OS.

- Owner decision (2026-10-27, review): keep the CLI tool package (`squalify.Cli.csproj` already has IsPackable and PackAsTool), so `dotnet pack squalify.sln` gives two packages: the library `squalor.squalify` and the `squalify` .NET tool. The pack test packs the library project explicitly. Both stay unpublished.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `dotnet pack` produces one package whose version matches the squalify version reported in descriptors.
- A throwaway consumer project restores the package from a local folder feed and profiles a synthetic file to the same descriptor bytes as the CLI.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: - Ask the owner which feed to publish to before publishing anywhere; a local folder feed is enough for the tests.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
